question: Does the corrected placement of pages with large red initials show unusual spacing under a uniform 13-of-58 page-placement control?
classification: Exploratory follow-up to a source feature-extraction error. The page list and separation threshold were inspected before this plan; p-values describe the declared comparison only.
population: LP2 pages 00 through 57, in printed release order; binary presence on a page if at least one red component has 10000 or more full-resolution-equivalent pixels at half-resolution sampling and four-connectivity.
comparison: Uniform random 13-page subsets of the 58 positions, sampled without replacement; 100000 trials from Python random.Random(3301). The source's 15-page total-red list is a descriptive comparator, not another null.
statistics: Internal-gap population variance; report both lower and upper empirical tails. Low variance does not distinguish periodic spacing from a contiguous block.
Span from first to last selected page, lower tail for page clustering.
Longest run of consecutive selected pages, upper tail for local clustering.
zlib level-9 compressed byte length of the 58 presence bits, right padded to 64 bits, lower tail; report ties and whether this test has any discrimination.
significance_reporting: Plus-one Monte Carlo estimates (tail hits + 1)/(100000 + 1). Report all tails and the minimum Bonferroni-adjusted tail probability across the five declared directions; do not call a null result proof against an encoded message.
controls: Thirteen approximately equally spaced positions including endpoints must show low internal-gap variance.
Thirteen consecutive positions must show a short span and a long run; the variance test alone may also respond and must not be called a cluster detector.
The original 15-page source list and corrected 13-page list must reproduce the sets in the image-audit table.
exclusions: Rune identities, red centroid positions, multiple initials on one page, page artwork, arbitrary decoders, nonuniform author placement, and any claim that a message has or has not been hidden.
administrative_amendment: Line endings and the image-audit stdout writer were made platform-stable after the original result. The page set, rules, random seed and controls are unchanged.
